6610.title: Mobile viewport geometry and caret validation
6610.rootCauseOneLine: Keyboard-open safe-area collapse shifts a focused editor; stale native WebKit caret painting remains unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: Static diff targets selection repaint; reconcile with current main and verify native iOS caret pixels.

6610.proposedFix: Verify the native symptom on an iPhone and compare a guarded post-layout selection refresh with an unchanged control. Do not duplicate the existing open PR.
6610.caveats: The same agent repeated the layout diagnostic in a second clean checkout (15/15 tests each). Neither run reproduced native iOS caret painting. Screenshots show Linux Chromium diagnostics only. Complete test and harness sources are inline in the report; raw artifacts are not published under the reports repository policy.
